shared_elements: carved/painted linear outline figures on a flat surface
justification: A shows a densely carved pillar with registers of animals (quadrupeds, birds, serpentine forms) and abstract bands stacked vertically in relief, while B shows a single isolated schematic figure with raised arms and outstretched limbs beside a small hooked/animal-like sign. The only correspondence is the generic presence of schematic animal or anthropomorphic outline forms; the multi-register crowded composition of A has no counterpart in the sparse, single-motif layout of B.
